notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If the up to seven lands can tap to produce at least {7}, this combo nets infinite mana.
